caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, shallow wooden pot or pan with a long, tapered wooden handle attached to its side. The vessel has a light brown color with visible wood grain texture throughout its surface. The cylinder forming the body of the pot is joined at the side with small, evenly spaced rivets, which are visible in a vertical line connecting the overlapping edges. The handle is smoothly shaped and slightly darker in hue than the body, attached at an angle using a rounded joint. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition. Shadows and highlights are used to indicate the form and the three-dimensional aspect of the pot and handle.
title: Grain Scoop
